defs.def: to cook food, especially meat, without liquid in an oven or over a fire; to be cooked in this way 烘，烤，焙（肉等）

ex.s: Campers learn technical skills of roasting, frying and cutting, as well as some recipes that they can take home and share with their families.

defs.def: to cook nuts, beans, etc. in order to dry them and turn them brown; to be cooked in this way 烘烤，焙，炒（坚果、豆子等）

ex.s: He also does a typical Sunday roast.
ex.t: 他还做典型的周日烤肉。

ex.s: He also can make a typical Sunday roast.
ex.t: 他也能做典型的周日烤肉。

defs.def: to be very angry with sb; to criticize sb strongly （对某人）非常生气，严厉批评
to become or to make sth become very hot in the sun or by a fire 曝晒；烘烤

ex.s: We all love roast beef and vegetables, but Mum says that, according to traditional Chinese medicine, our bodies will get hot and wear out after we eat too much roast food.
ex.t: 我们都喜欢烤牛肉和蔬菜，但妈妈说，根据中医的说法，吃太多烤制食物后我们的身体会发热上火并损耗身体。

defs.def: a large piece of meat that is cooked whole in the oven 烤肉

ex.s: It consists of roast meat, roast potatoes and vegetables.
ex.t: 它包括烤肉、烤土豆和蔬菜。

defs.def: a party that takes place in sb's garden/yard at which food is cooked over an open fire 常构成复合词

ex.s: We all love roast beef and vegetables, but Mum says we'd better not eat too much roast food as it may make us suffer from heat inside our bodies, according to traditional Chinese medicine.
ex.t: 我们都喜欢烤牛肉和蔬菜，但妈妈说我们最好不要吃太多烤制食物，因为根据中医的说法，这可能会使我们身体内热上火。

defs.def: an event, especially a meal, at which people celebrate sb's life by telling funny stories about them 耍笑庆祝会（常为宴会，讲述主角的滑稽事）
